A small browser toolkit

One bookmark. One useful job.

Five tools for everyday tasks. Drag a button to your bookmarks bar, then run it on the page you're working on.

Drag to install →

Show your bookmarks bar with Ctrl + Shift + B in Chrome or Edge on Windows. Drag a green button below onto the bar. Clicking it here shows instructions.

01

⬇ Logo Grab

Finds the current site's favicon or app icon, prioritises SVG and larger declared sizes, and downloads a square PNG.

⬇ Logo Grab

Open the website you want an icon from, then run Logo Grab. The PNG is named after the site's hostname.

Details and manual installation

Uses icons declared by the page, rather than searching page content for a brand logo. The PNG is at least 256 × 256 pixels; enlarging a small icon does not add detail. If CORS prevents export, it shows the original image for manual saving in its original format.

Readable source

02

Passphrases

Creates a three-word passphrase with punctuation, varied initial capitalisation and a two-digit number, then copies it to the clipboard.

Passphrases

Run on a normal webpage. A notification shows the generated passphrase; if copying fails, a prompt lets you copy it manually.

Details and manual installation

Retains the supplied wordlists, format and Math.random-based generation algorithm. Generates locally without a server request; the notification displays the passphrase on the current page for five seconds.

Readable source · Original project

03

Halo link

Copies a formatted hyperlink to the open Halo ticket, using its ticket number and summary as the link text.

Halo link

Open a ticket in the Halo agent interface, run Halo link, then paste into an application that supports rich text, such as Outlook or Teams.

Details and manual installation

Requires the expected ticket number and summary elements and an id URL parameter. Plain-text destinations may discard the hyperlink formatting; Halo interface changes may require selector updates.

Readable source

04

TidyRhea

Adds a collapse/expand button to Rhea's sidebar, giving forms more space and remembering the sidebar preference in this browser.

TidyRhea

Open Rhea, run TidyRhea, then use the arrow button to toggle the sidebar. Running the bookmarklet again also toggles it.

Details and manual installation

Only runs on rhea.private.aus-1.datixcloudiq.com. The preference is stored in that site's local storage. Re-run after a full page reload to restore the control and saved preference.

Readable source

05

🪟 Window Resizer

Opens the current page in a new window at a preset size or custom width and height.

🪟 Window Resizer

Run on the page you want to resize. Choose 1280 × 720, 1366 × 768 or 1920 × 1080, or enter custom dimensions.

Details and manual installation

Requests whole-window dimensions in CSS pixels, including the title bar and borders. Browser and operating-system limits may adjust the actual size. Allow pop-ups for the current site when prompted.

Readable source

Can't drag? Copy a bookmarklet URL and paste it into a bookmark's URL field. Bookmarklets run in the active page; browser pages and restrictive site policies can block them.

GitHub repo & README · Generated from readable JavaScript, with no external scripts or tracking.
